new_value: {"notes":"Completed GPS/time-provider to ASN/SFN derivation on 2026-08-27. Preserved canonical duration-parametric unsigned API and made its result commit output-atomic. Added strict scheduling-facing Unix-UTC sample API that rejects invalid wall clock/source/stratum/timescale, negative or non-normalized timestamps, seconds-to-microseconds overflow, samples below effective epoch floor, pre-epoch values, and zero duration without mutating output. Raw GPS scale must be leap-offset-converted by the provider; representable Unix UTC instants remain consecutive across leap boundaries. Focused generated C consumer covers all 12 format-v2 canonical vectors plus floor equality, integer rounding, SFN wrap, uint64 max, negative/range/overflow and atomic errors. Validation: host strict C23+UBSan CTest 1/1 PASS; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 32-bit runtime 4/4 PASS; Python canonical consumer 3/3 PASS; Rust canonical consumer 1/1 PASS; canonical generator --check, Ruff, and diff check PASS. No shared-path collision."}
